_comment: Add a _ before an option name to comment it out and it wont be added to the apworld
Using 'goal' as the name of an option let you override some of the generated goal parameters
goal.description: How to End your Randomized playthrough.

filler_traps._comment: Using values here let you set a 'recommended' filler_trap percentage or even a default percentage

description: Enable checks and items exclusively related to the alternate endings of chapters 1, 3, and 6.
Adds 11 checks to the slot, and 6 items to the pool.
If Charactersanity is also enabled, adds a further 19 checks.
Enable checks for talking to every unique character in the game.
These checks are considered to be in logic as soon as the character can first be encountered in the story.
If Alternate Endings are also enabled, adds a further 15 checks.
